Steps.Text: Welcome, Duelist. I'm the Prismatic. I'll be guiding you through the journey of our realms.
{realm:Each realm} will require three fights with {enemy:enemies} before you can move on, and you must win within your {clock:allotted time}.
Each card in your deck is an attack or a defend. They have a form, an element, and a cost. This is a slashing ice attack that costs two AP.
Defends cancel attacks and always choose the most effective attack to stop first. This is a defending fire card that costs 2 AP and provides two fire shields.
Use forms, elements, and specific cards to create hands and boost your damage. Choose those three slices and attack with a three of a kind hand, duelist.
Use forms, elements, and specific cards to create hands and boost your damage. Choose those three slices and attack with a three of a kind hand, duelist.
Use forms, elements, and specific cards to create hands and boost your damage. Choose those three slices and attack with a three of a kind hand, duelist.

Your damage is based on {duelist-dmg:your DMG stat} and multiplies by the strength of an attacking card and then by the multiplier of your hand. Each attack deals its own damage. This arcane crushing attack deals 3x your DMG stat and costs 3 AP. If you are ever in doubt, {ledger-button:check the ledger} for how a card calculated damage.
Attacking with the element of your enemy will not hurt them.  A fire club can still be used to form a hand against this fire goblin, but don't expect it to hurt.

Defending with the element of your enemy will surge your abilities, allowing you to perform more actions on your next turn. Choose the dual fire shield and the fire Thump and the arcane Smash cards to attack with a pair and defend yourself.

Now with surging power you can defeat your enemy.

Vitae is the currency of the realms. After victory you will gain interest on what you already carry, a small amount based on your remaining health, and some vitae from the fallen enemy based on their power.
Each victory grants you an essence to alter your deck. Choose either.

I will bring you {relics:relics}, {consumables:spells}, {potions:potions}, and {elixir:elixirs} to prepare you for the next fight. {relics:Relics} stay with you until you sell them, {consumables:some you can save}, and {potions:others will always be in the shop}. Each realm has a {elixir:single elixir} to offer for a permanent upgrade.  Good luck duelist.
